title: The Septuagint reads 'angels of God' in Genesis 6

tellings.quote: And in the Septuagent, when you read Genesis 6, it doesn't say the sons of God. It says the angels of God.

plain: In the Septuagint, the ancient Greek translation of the Hebrew Bible, the passage in Genesis 6 where heavenly beings take human wives does not say "the sons of God". It says "the angels of God". The researcher Tim Alberino makes this point himself, without naming a source, as evidence that the ancient translators understood those beings to be angels.
